crossRefs.note: For there will be a day of Yahweh of Armies for all that is proud and arrogant, and for all that is lifted up; and it…
You will say, ‘I will go up to the land of unwalled villages. I will go to those who are at rest, who dwell securely…
Then he answered and spoke to me, saying, “This is Yahweh’s word to Zerubbabel, saying, ‘Not by might, nor by power…

translations.web: I will cut off the cities of your land, and will tear down all your strongholds.
translations.bsb: I will remove the cities of your land and tear down all your strongholds.
translations.kjv: And I will cut off the cities of thy land, and throw down all thy strong holds:
translations.asv: and I will cut off the cities of thy land, and will throw down all thy strongholds.
